name: MIKROMB
recent: Mikro MSC 正在推进以 RM30 million 收购 Broadguard Sdn Bhd 100% 股权的交易，对价通过发行 51,724,138 股新股支付，新股将于 2026 年 11 月 19 日上市。公司近期也出现多项管理层变动，包括三名主要官员的更换。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收和净利均环比增长。
notable: 拟以 RM30 million 收购 Broadguard Sdn Bhd 100% 股权，对价通过发行 51,724,138 股新股支付。
Bursa Securities 于 2026 年 9 月 21 日批准 51,724,138 股对价新股上市。
公司三名主要官员（Encik Badlishah bin Ab Hapidz、Mr Tay Siang Hui、Mr Chan Yaw Sang）出现变动。
risks: 收购对价以新股支付，将扩大股本并可能摊薄现有股东持股。
执行董事兼董事经理 Mr Yim Yuen Wah 在闭门期內增持 22,200,000 股（1.837%）。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM20.346 million，环比增长 15.9%，同比增长 3.9%；净利为 RM4.905 million，环比增长 23.3%，同比增长 58.0%；净利率为 24.1%，高于上一季度的 22.7%。

recent_en: Mikro MSC is proceeding with its RM30 million acquisition of 100% of Broadguard Sdn Bhd, satisfied via the issuance of 51,724,138 new shares, which are scheduled to be listed on 19 November 2026. The company also saw several management changes, including the replacement of three principal officers. Revenue and net profit both grew quarter-on-quarter in the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of 100% of Broadguard Sdn Bhd for RM30 million, to be satisfied via the issuance of 51,724,138 new shares.
Bursa Securities approved the listing of 51,724,138 consideration shares on 21 September 2026.
Changes in three principal officers: Encik Badlishah bin Ab Hapidz, Mr Tay Siang Hui and Mr Chan Yaw Sang.
risks_en: The acquisition consideration is paid in new shares, which will enlarge the share base and may dilute existing shareholders.
Executive Director / Managing Director Mr Yim Yuen Wah acquired 22,200,000 shares (1.837%) during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM20.346 million, up 15.9% QoQ and 3.9% YoY; net profit was RM4.905 million, up 23.3% QoQ and 58.0% YoY; net margin was 24.1%, higher than 22.7% in the previous quarter.
